---

## Problem

Identify fraudulent credit card transactions from European cardholders (September 2013), where fraud is a tiny fraction of all transactions.

## Approach

Handling extreme class imbalance and choosing metrics suited to the problem, comparing classification models.

## Technologies

[Python]{.tag} [scikit-learn]{.tag} [Imbalanced classification]{.tag} [XGBoost]{.tag} [Optuna]{.tag} [SHAP]{.tag} [Streamlit]{.tag}

## Results

With a **578:1** imbalance across 284,807 transactions, the model reached **PR-AUC 0.826**, recall 0.811 and precision 0.951 at a 0.264 threshold, chosen from the precision-recall curve rather than the 0.5 default. PR-AUC was used instead of ROC-AUC, which is misleading under extreme imbalance.
